title: Mother and Children Under Patio Umbrella, 1950s B&W Backyard Snapshot Photo
description: A classic mid-century family scene showing a young mother sitting outdoors in a deckled folding chair beneath a fringed patio umbrella. She holds a toddler boy in a striped shirt on her lap while smiling towards a young daughter seated in a matching folding chair beside her. A round patio table sits in the background amidst trees and foliage on a sunny afternoon.
